text:
Maya: Heads-up 1 PR #8567 needs reviewers: small migration note, two SDK snippets (js/python), and a broken internal link flagged by preview. Can someone claim before EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

docs-bot: Preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/8567 1 Linkcheck: 1 broken link (docs/migration-guide.md#legacy-auth).

Tom: I can take JS snippets and the link check. Free most of the afternoon.

Eli: I'll do the Python snippet and verify async examples. Quick note 1 python sample shows `Client()` usage but v3 prefers `AsyncClient`. I'll propose a corrected snippet.

Priya: Happy to do final docs pass for tone and the migration intro. If Tom/Eli finish their passes tag me and I'll merge.

Tom: Fixed anchor in migration-guide.md and pushed. Also standardized code fence lang tags in JS examples. Re-running preview.

docs-bot: Preview updated: linkcheck passed ✅

Eli: Submitted tiny commit converting python snippet to AsyncClient and adding `async with` usage. Non-blocking nit: add a brief comment about closing clients for long-running apps.

Priya: Quick pass done 1 adjusted a line in the intro for clarity and added a one-sentence migration summary. Looks good to me.

Maya: Great work 1 tagging @Priya for final merge when ready. Thanks Tom/Eli! :clap:

Priya: Merged at 17:20 PT. Thanks everyone.
